Goal : This script integrates four layers of data at enhancer DMRs (differentially
methylated regions) to see how chromatin changes relate to gene expression at day 2 (D2):

- H3K4me1 differential signal (log fold change)
- ATAC-seq differential accessibility (MATAC fold change)
- Enhancer DMRs (`up` / `down`, with enhancer type and associated gene)
- RNA-seq differential expression of the gene associated with each enhancer


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
```

# Enhancer dmr
```{r}
# Differential H3K4me1 peaks for each comparison (BED-like tables with header)
D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1 <- read.table("D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K4me1.bed",header = TRUE)
D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1 <- read.table("D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1.bed", header = TRUE)
D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1 <- read.table("D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1.bed", header = TRUE)
D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_H3K4me1 <- read.table("D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_H3K4me1.bed",header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1 <- dplyr::rename(D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1,LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold )
D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1 <- dplyr::rename(D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1,LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold )
D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1 <- dplyr::rename(D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1,LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold )
D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_H3K4me1 <- dplyr::rename(D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_H3K4me1,LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold )
```

```{r}
D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC <- read.delim("D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC.csv", header = TRUE, quote = "", fill = TRUE)
D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC <- D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC %>% mutate (Fold_MATAC = Fold*-1) # also do this for df_D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3 because order contrast isn't correct
D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC <- read.table("diff_peaks_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC.tsv",header = TRUE)
D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_MATAC <- read.table("diff_peaks_D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_MATAC.tsv", header = TRUE)
D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC <- read.table("diff_peaks_D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC.tsv", header = TRUE)
D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC <- D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC %>% mutate (Fold_MATAC = Fold*-1)

```


```{r}

```


# Overlap H3K4me1 peaks with enhancer DMRs

For each comparison: convert both tables to GRanges, find overlaps, and keep
the H3K4me1 peaks that overlap an enhancer DMR together with the DMR annotations. Duplicated peaks are removed with distinct().
```{r}
gr_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1 <- GRanges(
  seqnames = D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1$Chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1$Start, end = D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1$End),
  LogFC_H3K4me1 = D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1$LogFC_H3K4me1

)
gr_Enhancer_dmr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = Enhancer_dmr$seqnames,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = Enhancer_dmr$start, end = Enhancer_dmr$end),
  Enhancer_type = Enhancer_dmr$annot.type.1,
  cat = Enhancer_dmr$dmr_type,
  gene_name =Enhancer_dmr$gene_name

)
hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_enhancer_dmr <- findOverlaps(gr_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1, gr_Enhancer_dmr)

result_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1_dmr <- cbind(
  as.data.frame(gr_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1)[queryHits(hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_enhancer_dmr), ],
  Enhancer_type = gr_Enhancer_dmr$Enhancer_type[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_enhancer_dmr)],
  cat = gr_Enhancer_dmr$cat[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_enhancer_dmr)],
  gene_name =gr_Enhancer_dmr$gene_name[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_enhancer_dmr)]


) %>%
  distinct(seqnames, start, end, .keep_all = TRUE)
head(result_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1_dmr)
nrow(result_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_H3K4me1_dmr)
```

# Overlap MATAC peaks with enhancer DMRs

Same logic as above, but for the ATAC-seq (MATAC) differential peaks. Only the
peak coordinates and Fold_MATAC are kept here; DMR annotations come from the
H3K4me1 tables


```{r}

  Fold_MATAC = D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC$Fold_MATAC

)

gr_Enhancer_dmr <- GRanges(

  ranges   = IRanges(start = Enhancer_dmr$start, end = Enhancer_dmr$end),
  Enhancer_type = Enhancer_dmr$annot.type.1,
  cat = Enhancer_dmr$dmr_type
  

)
hits_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_MATAC_dmr <- findOverlaps(gr_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_MATAC, gr_Enhancer_dmr)

result_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_K4M_WT_MATAC_dmr <- cbind(
```

#. Combine MATAC and H3K4me1 at enhancer DMRs

For each comparison, overlap MATAC peaks (in enhancer DMRs) with H3K4me1 peaks
(in enhancer DMRs). The result  has one row per MATAC peak with
its Fold_MATAC, the matching LogFC_H3K4me1, enhancer type, DMR category and gene.



```{r}
gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr$seqnames,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr$start, end = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr$end),
  Fold_MATAC = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr$Fold_MATAC,
)

gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$seqname,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$start, end = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$end),
  LogFC_H3K4me1 = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$LogFC_H3K4me1,
  Enhancer_type = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$Enhancer_type,
  cat = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$cat,
  gene_name = result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$gene_name

)

hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr <- findOverlaps(gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr, gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr)

scatterplot_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr <- cbind(
  as.data.frame(gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_MATAC_dmr)[queryHits(hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr), ],
  LogFC_H3K4me1 = gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$LogFC_H3K4me1[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)],
  Enhancer_type = gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$Enhancer_type[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)],
    cat = gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$cat[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)],
   gene_name = gr_result_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_H3K4me1_dmr$gene_name[subjectHits(hits_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)]


) %>%
  distinct(seqnames, start, end, .keep_all = TRUE)
head(scatterplot_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)
nrow(scatterplot_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr)
```

```{r}
# replace "NaN" labels (genes not differentially expressed) by "n.s." (not significant)

clean_NoDiff <- function(df, colname) {
  df[[colname]][df[[colname]] == "NaN"] <- "n.s."
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
scatterplot_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr <- clean_NoDiff(scatterplot_D2_TKO_H3_vs_H3_WT_dmr, "thresh_adjp005_fc1_TKO.H3.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2")

scatterplot_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_dmr <- clean_NoDiff(scatterplot_D2_TKO_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_H3_dmr, "thresh_adjp005_fc1_TKO.H3K4M.D2_vs_TKO.H3.D2")

scatterplot_D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_dmr <- clean_NoDiff(scatterplot_D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_dmr, "thresh_adjp005_fc1_WT.H3K4M.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2")
```
